method: Items are published only when an official primary source or at least two independent publishers support them.

items.headline: Viet Nam's prime minister begins official visit to Cambodia at Hun Manet's invitation
items.summary: Vietnamese Prime Minister Le Minh Hung arrived in Phnom Penh on 9 October for an official visit running to 10 October. Cambodia's foreign ministry said on 6 October that the two leaders would discuss strengthening bilateral relations, cooperation and regional and international issues. No outcomes had been reported at the time of writing.
items.note: Both sources are Vietnamese state outlets; the underlying announcement is an official Cambodian foreign ministry statement. Outcomes of the talks are not yet known.
